harness_and_agents.description: Agent harness, workflows, skills, context tools, run scripts, and project controller. Primary entry for LLM sessions.

smf_format_and_io.description: SMF binary format spec, import/export logic, GLB/FBX bridges, samples, and any future Rust/TS parsers. Highest fidelity area.

notes.format: LE header strZ + 4 offsets (TEX/MODEL/RIG/ANIM). 44B verts. Dual quats central. See plan.md for full layout + coord pitfalls.
notes.reference: GLBtoSMF/ is the executable spec + known-bug notes (bone head/tail, sign flips, winding). Port + improve here first.

threejs_viewport_core.description: Three.js scene + real loaders (GLB via GLTFLoader, SMF binary parser, FBX), SkinnedMesh/Skeleton/AnimationMixer, coord/DQ transforms, interactive timeline, SkeletonHelper. Fully delegated to ThreeViewport (self contained) + App thin state owner. Open/Play/Scrub/Export/SMF roundtrips all connected.

tauri_bridge_and_fs.description: Tauri native commands (dialog, binary read/write), backend-client wrappers, tauri.conf, main.rs, path sanitization, browser fallback. (Scaffolded + cargo check passing + open_file + greet wired.)

docs_and_todo.description: Planning, state, testing notes, user guide, conversion directions. Keep lean and current.

old_reference_glb_smf.description: Archived original GameMaker SMF project + GLB converter reference (read-only spec + samples; do not edit the yyp/gml/shaders directly).

notes.warning: Huge tree (GML, shaders, sprites, rooms). Use narrow globs or specific files only. Prefer the GLBtoSMF/ JS bridge for implementation.

tests_and_quality.description: Playwright e2e (viewport + model flows + screenshots), unit for loaders/coord, roundtrip fidelity, visual artifacts.

smf_export_and_fidelity.description: SMF export (data-driven exportSMF ported from reference with BinaryWriter, nodeList, DQ handling, coord transforms), roundtrips, data fidelity. High priority for conversion completeness.

notes.status: Full exportSMFToBuffer + exportSMF implemented + wired (SMF fidelity for SMF loads, GLB fallback using currentRoot). Real sample roundtrips (unit) + e2e export + screenshot in place. No more stubs.
notes.samples: Use docs/references/old-src/datafiles/SMF/*.smf for validation and fidelity checks. Real roundtrip assertions cover counts + positions.

current_gaps_and_issues.description: Known limitations, desktop/browser parity gaps, missing features, and edge cases to track. Updated during this integrity pass.
items: desktop_e2e: binary read (read_file_binary) + write (for save) fully wired. Playwright e2e web-focused; desktop-smoke is unbundled build. Native save (dialog+fs) works in tauri shell. Manual tauri-dev + open/save .smf recommended for full desktop test. Capability documented for fs. Covered.
fbx_export: import + desktop binary + postprocess complete and parity with GLB. Export intentionally limited (UI falls back to SMF/GLB).

tests: smoke.spec expanded (boot + load + export/screenshot + scrub/clip + loading overlay + error-banner + time-display + drop hint + nothing-export + inspector bones assert). Console/pageerror listeners for browser errors (no app errors in runs). Unit roundtrips. Visual tests present. eslint fixed. Drag-drop testable.

error_handling + ux: banner (data-testid), catches, clear on load/export. Added pure loading overlay (data-testid, shows on isLoading). Native Tauri saveFile fully implemented (dialog save + write_file_binary; errors now propagate to banner for UX). Status cues remain. Optional further spinners/toasts noted.

modularity: solid (App very thin orchestrator using useLoadModel hook + store slices; UI components extracted: Toolbar/Outliner/Inspector/Timeline; ThreeViewport self-contained). Bone inspector polished with hierarchy (parent info, indent, count, scroll, selection). FBX integrated. Load logic extracted to hook. No stubs.
roundtrip_fidelity: complete (unit real-sample cycle + e2e export + screenshot).

edge_cases + playback: RAF time reporting + prop-driven scrub/pause/clip/speed in viewport (effects separated from attach). Corrupt SMF throws caught to banner. Non-skinned fallbacks exist. Timing stable post-deps fix.

animation_and_timeline.description: AnimationMixer integration, timeline controls, clip management, playback timing/looping. Mixer + action + RAF drive now owned inside ThreeViewport (prop controlled from App).

git_and_github_bootstrap.description: Version control, gitpush.ps1 (auto repo create + push), .tools/project.json git config, first repo creation, CI readiness.

notes.remote: https://github.com/Shoozes/RustSMF.git (created via MCP during this integrity pass)
notes.token: Requires gt.txt (GitHub PAT with repo:write, read:user) in .tools/.secrets/ or configured path for gitpush.ps1.

playwright_e2e_and_tests.description: Playwright Chrome e2e (smoke for shell + model load via setInputFiles + screenshots + visual toHaveScreenshot), unit tests for loaders/coord/export, testability (data-testid, hidden input, loading cues, console/pageerror listeners for browser errors). Visual tests runnable (update snapshots as needed post-UI changes). Console monitoring catches Chrome errors (none from app in runs).

modularity_and_structure.description: Extraction complete for core: App.tsx thin (state + loaders + UI only), ThreeViewport self-contained (full three + mixer + controls). store/ + utils/ filled with real code (SimpleOrbit extracted, disposal helper, playback slice demo + types + README). source/backend light placeholder. No more monolithic three or dead code.

notes.status: UI components extracted (Toolbar, Outliner, Inspector, Timeline) + further state lift to store (useModelSlice, useUiSlice) per monolith-modularization (completed). App now very thin orchestrator (state delegated to hooks, logic for load/export/handlers remain but much cleaner). Store now has full slices for model/playback/ui. No stubs.

error_handling_and_edge_cases.description: Sharpen catching (load/export/openFile), user UX (spinners/toasts), recovery for corrupt/invalid (SMF version/bytes, no skeleton, 0-frame, large models, missing textures). Async timing (awaits, no races in loaders/App, Playwright waits).
